correctness.rationale: The frozen proof lists all 24 vertices and 48 edges as 24 axial-square plus 24 swap edges, invariant under positive diagonal stretch; ordered absolute weighted normal components a>b>c>0 are exhaustive by symmetry. Six feasible sign patterns of A=rb-a-c,B=rb-a+c,C=rc-a-b,D=rc-a+b all give N=8+4 1_{B>0}. Direct independent sampled edge-crossing classifications agreed with the exact 8 iff a>rb+c law. For each of six orderings, the cone with rays (e_i,re_i+pe_j,(r+1)e_i+pe_j+qe_k) has spherical solid angle 2 arctan(pq/denominator). Eight sign octants over area 4pi give the stated 2/pi coefficient. The source verifier uses exact Q(sqrt2) edge and chamber tests; its Haar simulation is diagnostic, not the infinite-direction proof.
